ModMetaData.name: RimMT D.2.2 - Clean Pathfinding A1

ModMetaData.description: D.2.2 companion patch for Clean Pathfinding 2. Adds a bounded 30-tick per-map glow-cost cache and appends counters to RimMT Diagnostics reports. The D.2.2 core DLL remains unchanged.
